scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n api,web,sync "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run sync:watch -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:integration && npm run test:ui
